recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future rule that defaults Expression.language when no library is present should be handled as a new CDS work-group decision, not as remaining application work for FHIR-16705.
issue_request: FHIR-16705 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification CDS STU3 ballot issue noting that a dynamicValue example showed only a description and lacked an expression language; the final resolution said documentation would be updated based on the new Expression datatype.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly naming FHIR-16705 was found. The Jira comments say the issue had been applied by changing examples to use the Expression type, and the relevant 2018 implementation history is commit 3dc81b908557be64248363dc4e5bbf5ed5213965, which changed ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition dynamicValue.expression to Expression and updated examples to nest language and expression under Expression.
additional_context: Current build-scope source lists ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition as active resources assigned to CDS, includes Expression as an active metadata type, and includes the Clinical Reasoning expression pages in hierarchy.xml. The Using Expressions topic explains Expression.language, shows dynamicValue examples with language, and documents single-vs-multiple library expression resolution. Related issues FHIR-16776 and FHIR-16780 were implemented in the same Expression-datatype commit; FHIR-16711 has already been audited separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The old missing-language shape is absent from current ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition examples, and adding default-language semantics now would go beyond the published resolution and the current Expression.language model.
